coordinate_contract.chunk_grid: Nigeria-wide equirectangular grid centered at 9 degrees latitude; stable 500 m cells

data_terms: Composite output. OSM-derived geography is ODbL-1.0 with OpenStreetMap attribution. LGA data retains conservative upstream ODbL lineage and its pinned MIT repository notice. MIT source notices for ward and settlement-name subsets remain component-specific; no one source license supersedes the others.

sources.data_lineage: README acknowledges the dr5hn countries-states-cities database; conservatively retain its ODbL-1.0 database notice.
sources.attribution: LGA source derived from the pinned xosasx repository; upstream dr5hn attribution and ODbL notice retained.

sources.data_lineage: Filtered 11-row Akure South ward reference-point subset; coordinate role is unspecified by the source.
Ondo capital/town name subset only; no settlement coordinate or boundary is supplied.

sources.crs_review: Preview WKT has no embedded CRS field; axis order was checked against the declared Akure viewport, Nigeria coordinate ranges, and named Akure features plus the pinned Ondo/Akure South reference point.
sources.repository_license: MIT (extractor code only; not the map data)
sources.data_lineage: Bounded WGS84 feature sample extracted from an attributed preview; source HTML does not retain original OSM tags.

sources.attribution: Viewport, layer mapping, caps, and source snapshot declaration maintained in this repository.

rules: 37 unique state/FCT codes and 774 unique source LGA records; stable canonical IDs do not depend on optional Wikidata identifiers.
Duplicate optional Wikidata identifiers are reported and omitted from normalized external IDs.
WGS84 coordinate ranges and broad Nigeria bounds are validated; source administrative points are not relabeled as boundaries or centroids.
The Akure South viewport is a bounded sample, not an administrative boundary; each retained OSM geometry intersects it and remains within a 0.05 degree safety margin.
GeoJSON geometry structure, ring closure, OSM source IDs/layers, unique feature IDs, per-feature chunk coverage, and output provenance are validated.
